# Project Phoenix v45.0 — 12-Era AI Strategic Calibration (Main Mod, 1337-1836, AI-only, additive, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v450_ai_and_audio_calibration.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country scope. Strips all v45.0 Main Mod AI calibration modifiers (guarantees human players & rebels never hold them).
oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_late_medieval_restraint } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_late_medieval_restraint }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_anatolian_balkan_focus } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_anatolian_balkan_focus }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_discovery_atlantic_pace } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_discovery_atlantic_pace }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_discovery_continental_restraint } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_discovery_continental_restraint }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_confessional_coalition_balance } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_confessional_coalition_balance }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_gunpowder_frontier_cohesion } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_gunpowder_frontier_cohesion }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_revolutionary_mobilization } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_revolutionary_mobilization }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_early_industrial_fiscal } remove_country_modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_early_industrial_fiscal }
}

# Country scope. Applies era- & region-calibrated AI strategic posture for 1337-1836.
# Strictly AI-only, rebel-safe (R10), closed-interval (R31), and Fourth-Rome isolated (G_ELR_ISOLATION).
oe_v45_ai_apply_era_calibration = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = yes
				country_type = pop
				country_type = building
				has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
				has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
				has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
			}
		}
		oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
	}
	else = {
		# 1. Late Medieval Frontier Restraint (1337-1420)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1337
				current_year <= 1420
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tag = TUR
						tag = BYZ
						tag = SER
						tag = BUL
						capital ?= {
							OR = {
								region = region:anatolia_region
								region = region:balkan_region
							}
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_anatolian_balkan_focus years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_late_medieval_restraint years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
			}
		}
		# 2. Age of Discovery Colonial Pace (1492-1555)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1492
				current_year <= 1555
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					num_of_ports >= 3
					OR = {
						tag = CAS
						tag = SPA
						tag = POR
						tag = ENG
						tag = GBR
						tag = FRA
						tag = NED
						tag = HOL
						capital ?= {
							OR = {
								region = region:iberia_region
								region = region:great_britain_region
								region = region:france_region
							}
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_discovery_atlantic_pace years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_discovery_continental_restraint years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
			}
		}
		# 3. Confessional & Absolutist Balance (1555-1756)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1555
				current_year <= 1756
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					num_locations >= 20
					OR = {
						tag = TUR
						tag = MUG
						tag = MCH
						tag = CHI
						tag = MNG
						tag = IRA
						capital ?= {
							OR = {
								region = region:anatolia_region
								region = region:persia_region
								region = region:hindustan_region
								region = region:north_china_region
								region = region:east_china_region
								region = region:manchuria_region
							}
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_gunpowder_frontier_cohesion years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_great_power = yes
						num_locations >= 30
					}
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							continent = continent:europe
							region = region:maghreb_region
							region = region:egypt_region
						}
					}
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_confessional_coalition_balance years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
			}
		}
		# 4. Revolutionary & Early Industrial Cadence (1756-1836)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1756
				current_year <= 1836
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_great_power = yes
						num_locations >= 35
					}
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_revolutionary_mobilization years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					num_locations >= 12
					OR = {
						num_of_ports >= 4
						has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories
						has_embraced_institution = institution:industrialization
					}
				}
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_ai_mod_early_industrial_fiscal years = 2 mode = replace }
			}
			else = {
				oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
		}
	}
}
